en.heading: April: Panagyaman Rice Festival — a 2004 presidential declaration
en.origin: Panagyaman is a Filipino thanksgiving expression associated with the rice harvest. The Panagyaman Rice Festival Month is described in the original presidential document as a national celebration of successful rice cultivation and the labour of small farmers. Proclamation No. 606, signed by President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo on 19 April 2004, declared 'the month of April' as Panagyaman Rice Festival. It referred to hybrid rice production and irrigation programmes as the context of that year's celebration. The signed proclamation does not explicitly say 'April of every year' or create a recurring national non-working holiday. The NCCA cultural calendar continues to index an April month, but annual statutory recurrence and ongoing government adoption require an independent official check.
en.promoter: Department of Agriculture, local rice farmers and community harvest-festival organizers are the relevant government and community institutions identified by presidential sources for implementing the commemorative cultural programme.
en.purpose: Recognize the rice-harvest context while flagging the uncertain permanent annual legal status.

it.heading: Aprile: Panagyaman Rice Festival, la proclamazione del 2004
it.origin: Panagyaman è un'espressione di ringraziamento legata al raccolto del riso. Il documento presidenziale descrive il mese come celebrazione nazionale della coltivazione del riso e del lavoro dei piccoli agricoltori. La Proclamazione n. 606, firmata da Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo il 19 aprile 2004, dichiarò 'il mese di aprile' Panagyaman Rice Festival, richiamando programmi di irrigazione e riso ibrido. La proclamazione non dice espressamente 'ogni aprile' e non istituisce un mese di giorni non lavorativi. Il calendario NCCA lo elenca tuttora, ma la periodicità legale annuale richiede una verifica ufficiale separata.

de.heading: April: Panagyaman-Reisfestival und die Proklamation von 2004
de.origin: Panagyaman steht für Dankbarkeit bei der Reisernte. Der Präsidialtext beschreibt den Monat als nationale Feier erfolgreicher Reisproduktion und der Arbeit kleiner Landwirte. Proklamation Nr. 606 vom 19. April 2004 erklärte 'den Monat April' zum Panagyaman-Reisfestival und verwies auf Hybridreisanbau und Bewässerungsprogramme. Die Proklamation sagt nicht ausdrücklich 'jeden April' und schafft keine arbeitsfreien Tage. Der NCCA-Kalender führt den April weiter, doch eine dauerhafte Rechtsgrundlage muss zusätzlich bestätigt werden.

en.heading: 21–27 March: UNESCO–ITI World Theatre Week in the Philippines
en.origin: The Philippine UNESCO–ITI World Theatre Week showcases dramatic performance, cultural diversity, education and the ability of live theatre to connect communities. The local week culminates on 27 March, the date associated with international World Theatre Day. Proclamation No. 1262, signed on 21 March 2007 by President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, specifically designated 21–27 March 2007 and every year thereafter as the country's UNESCO–ITI World Theatre Week. The proclamation placed theatre activities under NCCA and the Philippine ITI Centre and referred to the 2006 Manila-hosted ITI World Congress. A later 2010 administrative order again refers to this theatre week. The national seven-day programme is distinct from the worldwide single day on 27 March.
en.promoter: National Commission for Culture and the Arts and the Philippine Centre of the International Theatre Institute are the relevant government and community institutions identified by presidential sources for implementing the commemorative cultural programme.
en.purpose: Encourage theatre education and cultural participation while keeping the Philippine seven-day week distinct from the global one-day observance.

it.heading: 21–27 marzo: la settimana UNESCO–ITI del teatro nelle Filippine
it.origin: La Settimana UNESCO–ITI del teatro nelle Filippine valorizza spettacolo dal vivo, diversità culturale ed educazione. Il periodo termina il 27 marzo, data della Giornata mondiale del teatro. La Proclamazione n. 1262, firmata da Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo il 21 marzo 2007, istituì espressamente il 21–27 marzo 2007 e ogni anno successivo come settimana nazionale UNESCO–ITI. La proclamazione affidò le attività a NCCA e ITI filippino e richiamò il congresso ITI ospitato a Manila nel 2006. Un ordine amministrativo del 2010 cita ancora la settimana, distinta dal solo 27 marzo mondiale.
